A legend, a pioneer, and smarter and funnier than 95% of anyone to ever hold elected office. 

www.huffpost.com/entry/barney...

I feel like I became aware of Applebee’s, Chili’s, and TGI Fridays, pretty much exactly the same time in the mid 1990s. It’s looking likely that Applebee’s will be the last one standing, and I would not have guessed that.

Yes. Words that are not palindromes but they appear in a very well known palindrome sentence. That’s not hard to grasp. 

And it’s okay that you haven’t ever heard or read “Able was I ere I saw Elba.” So this is a chance to learn, not a chance to whine that other people know something you don’t.

WAITRESS: You have to say it.
